tax.text: He proposes limiting near-term tax increases while using federal investment to support production and services.
tax.quote: Simply raising taxes or cutting spending does not solve our problems. We need better spending that invests in our people.

wages.text: He says he will support organized labor and backs higher teacher pay and a stronger voice for workers.
wages.quote: I intend to be a strong ally of organized labor, not just rhetorically, but through the policies I have promised to pursue.

trade.text: He says tariffs raise costs and reduce incentives to trade, and favors lower trade barriers.
trade.quote: For trade to work, the cost of exchanging must remain low. When barriers like tariffs are imposed, they disrupt this natural process by raising costs and reducing incentives to trade.

housing.text: He proposes expanding federal homebuilding programs to address housing costs and support community growth.
housing.quote: By expanding USDA homebuilding programs, investing in modern infrastructure, and strengthening small producers across the agricultural value chain, we can build new towns, revitalize old ones, and create pathways to asset ownership for American families.

schools.text: He supports increasing teacher pay and strengthening public schools.
schools.quote: I have also stated that I believe we need to substantially increase teacher pay and strengthen our public schools.

safety.text: He supports police accountability and community trust while also favoring mental health and addiction services as alternatives to incarceration.
safety.quote: We must also expand mental health and addiction services as alternatives to incarceration for nonviolent offenders.

immigration.text: He supports limited legal immigration and attracting talent alongside robust border security and planning for new arrivals.
immigration.quote: Limited legal immigration can fuel business development, consumer spending, and innovation. But these benefits require a strong domestic foundation, which includes robust border security to protect our communities.

health.text: He proposes expanding Medicaid eligibility and premium assistance, and reducing out-of-pocket costs for people on Medicare.
health.quote: On the consumer side, for working-age Americans, I would introduce legislation expanding premium assistance, reducing high deductibles through mandatory cost sharing, expanding Medicaid eligibility, and eliminating or nearly eliminating coinsurance liability.

tax.text: His official biography says he supports lower taxes and fewer regulations.
tax.quote: Congressman Guest is a lifelong conservative Republican who believes in limited government, traditional Mississippi values, free market economic principles of lower taxes and fewer regulations, the right to life of the unborn, a strong national defense with full support of our men and women in the military, and our Second Amendment gun rights and all of the other individual liberties guaranteed to us by the Constitution.

wages.text: Guest voted against the Raise the Wage Act, which would have raised the federal minimum wage.
wages.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Raise the Wage Act Vote Type: Recorded Vote Status: Passed

safety.text: His official biography says he has stood against the Defund the Police movement and describes his record prosecuting criminals.
safety.quote: Congressman Guest has stood firm against the #DefundThePolice Movement, pro-abortion groups, Socialistic policies, and other progressive agenda items.

immigration.text: His official biography says he is committed to securing the southwest border to curb illegal drug flows.
immigration.quote: Congressman Guest is committed to securing our country's southwest border to help curb the flow of illegal drugs into our communities.

guns.text: His official biography says he supports Second Amendment gun rights.
guns.quote: Congressman Guest is a lifelong conservative Republican who believes in limited government, traditional Mississippi values, free market economic principles of lower taxes and fewer regulations, the right to life of the unborn, a strong national defense with full support of our men and women in the military, and our Second Amendment gun rights and all of the other individual liberties guaranteed to us by the Constitution.

abortion.text: His official biography says he supports the right to life of the unborn.
abortion.quote: Congressman Guest is a lifelong conservative Republican who believes in limited government, traditional Mississippi values, free market economic principles of lower taxes and fewer regulations, the right to life of the unborn, a strong national defense with full support of our men and women in the military, and our Second Amendment gun rights and all of the other individual liberties guaranteed to us by the Constitution.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Guest voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which sets eligibility rules for women's sports by sex.
gender.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

cannabis.text: Guest voted against the MORE Act, which would have removed federal marijuana penalties and regulated legal cannabis.
cannabis.quote: Vote Question: On Passage MORE Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

voting.text: Guest voted for the SAVE Act, which requires documentary proof of citizenship for federal voter registration.
voting.quote: Vote Question: On Passage SAVE Act Vote Type: Yea-And-Nay Status: Passed

tax.text: He said the income tax should end and the Sixteenth Amendment should be amended or repealed.
tax.quote: The Income Tax is immoral, unethical, and akin to Slavery.

debt.text: He said he would vote against spending bills that add to the federal deficit.
debt.quote: I will vote against all spending bills that add to the federal deficit and contain earmarks.

housing.text: He supported zoning that preserves agricultural areas and low-density homesteads.
housing.quote: Zoning is important. Keep ag zones for ag and low-density homesteads.

immigration.text: He said undocumented immigrants should be sent home and described deportation as the solution.
immigration.quote: ALL the illegals need to be sent home. That’s my position on illegal immigrants.

guns.text: He said there should be no restrictions on gun ownership for law-abiding people.
guns.quote: None. Any ams the government can have should be ones law-abiding members of the public can have.

abortion.text: He said abortion policy belongs to states and that the federal government should not fund abortion.
abortion.quote: Abortion is not a federal matter. The 2022 U.S. Supreme Court ruling clarified abortion policy is a matter for the individual States.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He said bathroom use and participation in sports should follow biological sex.
gender.quote: People should use the appropriate bathrooms and participate in sports or the military according to their XX or XY biological reality.

health.text: He said the federal government should repeal the Affordable Care Act and other federal health-care laws.
health.quote: The federal government should repeal the failed Obamacare law and repeal all other federal laws regarding health care.

energy.text: He said policies that limit or reduce energy harm manufacturing, jobs and economic output.
energy.quote: Governmental policies to artificially limit or reduce energy cause destruction of the manufacturing and industrial sectors, jobs, and GDP.

voting.text: He said voter registration should require proof of citizenship and voting should require photo identification.
voting.quote: Registering to vote should require proof of citizenship. Voting should require photo identification. This is already law in Mississippi, and should be national law to protect our elections.
